use: Synthetic training and inspected development; no holdout claim
primary_review: Luna all new train/development facts blind to references
audit: Sol fixed 16 training cases and all 40 new development cases
filter: Exclude full family on failed review, input issue, unresolved question, policy error or teacher/audit disagreement
fitting: Old accepted train plus new accepted train; no development included
selection_development: Old corrected 16 plus accepted new 40; inspected development
candidates: End-to-end MiniLM, encoder LR 3e-5, head LR 1e-3, seeds 17 and 29, 20 epochs
selection: Maximum complete combined development agreement; earliest epoch; listed candidate order breaks ties
no_autoregressive_inference: Local encoders only; LLM used offline for labels and separately measured classifier reference
